faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is conducted by Gliders India Limited (GIL) for various posts under advertisement number 05/2026 on a Fixed Term Employment contract basis located in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What are the total vacancies available in Gliders India Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available across multiple positions including DGM, Managers, and Junior Assistant roles for eligible candidates holding professional degrees or graduation.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The final date to submit your complete application along with all essential documents via email is 20 October 2026. Make sure to apply well before the deadline to avoid any technical glitches.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary range offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive an annual CTC ranging from Rs. 3,60,000/- to Rs. 14,40,000/- depending upon the specific post and level of responsibility they are recruited for.

faq.question: Q5. How can I submit my application form?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted exclusively via Email. You need to send a single PDF file containing your application and documents to [email protected] with the appropriate subject line.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: General and OBC candidates are required to pay Rs. 500/- (or Rs. 200/- for Junior Assistant), whereas SC, ST, PWBD, Ex-servicemen, and Ex. Agniveers are completely exempted from the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the educational qualification needed for Junior Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Junior Assistant post must be a Graduate in any discipline with computer proficiency and a typing speed of 35 wpm in English or 30 wpm in Hindi.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for DGM - Product Development?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the DGM - Product Development post is 45 years, with standard age relaxations applicable for reserved categories such as SC/ST, OBC, and PWBD.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Gliders India vacancies?
faq.answer: The selection procedure consists of a written test or interview or both, determined by the total volume of applications received, requiring a minimum of 50% marks in each part.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the workplace located for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be posted in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, under Gliders India Limited establishments operating in the defence manufacturing sector.
